instruction: Pull over beside the white SUV closest to us on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearby white SUV on the left.|Park beside the prominent left-hand white SUV.

instruction: Pass the silver car on the left, then stop near the white car at the right edge.
paraphrases: Go past the left-hand silver car and pull over by the white car on the right.|After the silver car on the left, stop beside the right-edge white car.

instruction: Stop behind the closer white car on the left, not the dark car farther right.
paraphrases: Take the nearby white car on the left rather than the dark car on the right.|Pull over behind the left white car instead of the right-hand dark car.
What car is in front of us?|Identify the car directly ahead.
